title: Charlie Cat Forgot to Say Please: The Courtesy Key!

lines.text: Charlie the kitten jumped onto the dining table and yowled, Gimme a bowl of warm milk!
lines.caps: Charlie the kitten jumped onto the dining table and yowled, Gimme a bowl of *WARM | *MILK!

lines.text: He tapped his paws impatiently, but Mama Cat kept quietly reading her morning paper!
lines.caps: He tapped his paws impatiently, but Mama Cat kept quietly reading her *MORNING | *PAPER!

lines.text: I said give it to me right now! hissed Charlie, puffing up his gray tail!
lines.caps: I said give it to me right now! hissed *CHARLIE, | puffing up his gray *TAIL!

lines.text: Mama looked over her glasses and asked, What happened to your golden manners key?
lines.caps: Mama looked over her glasses and asked, What happened to your golden *MANNERS | *KEY?

lines.text: Barking orders makes people feel bossed around and closes their willingness to help!
lines.caps: Barking orders makes people feel bossed around and closes their *WILLINGNESS | to *HELP!

lines.text: Charlie sat down neatly, tucked his tail around his paws, and said softly, Please, Mama?
lines.caps: Charlie sat down neatly, tucked his tail around his paws, and said softly, *PLEASE, | *MAMA?

lines.text: Mama beamed, poured a creamy dish of milk with cinnamon, and stroked his furry ears!
lines.caps: Mama beamed, poured a creamy dish of milk with cinnamon, and stroked his *FURRY | *EARS!

lines.text: The word Please is a magical golden key that opens hearts with kindness and respect!
lines.caps: The word Please is a magical golden key that opens hearts with *KINDNESS | and *RESPECT!

lines.text: Unlock good manners every day with BabyBeats Rhymo!
